title.zh: 英国警方能否在2026年3月底前正式起诉曼德尔森勋爵？
title.en: Will UK police formally charge Lord Mandelson before the end of March 2026?

yes.zh: 英国警方在2026年3月31日前对曼德尔森勋爵提出正式刑事指控
yes.en: UK police formally charge Lord Mandelson with a criminal offence before March 31, 2026

no.zh: 截止日期前无正式起诉，调查仍在进行或被撤销
no.en: No formal charges filed before the deadline; investigation ongoing or dropped

title.zh: 曼德尔森勋爵文件能否在2026年3月前全部公开？
title.en: Will the Mandelson files be fully released to the public before March 2026?

yes.zh: 议会委员会在2026年3月31日前决定并公开全部曼德尔森相关文件
yes.en: Parliamentary committee decides and releases all Mandelson-related files before March 31, 2026

no.zh: 文件部分或全部被封锁，在��止日期前未能全部公开
no.en: Files remain partially or fully blocked and are not fully released before the deadline

title.zh: Reform UK能否赢得Gorton and Denton补选？
title.en: Will Reform UK win the Gorton and Denton by-election?

yes.zh: Reform UK候选人在Gorton and Denton补选中获得最多票数，当选议员
yes.en: Reform UK candidate wins the most votes in the Gorton and Denton by-election and is elected MP

no.zh: 其他政党候选人赢得该补选
no.en: A candidate from another party wins the by-election

title.zh: 斯塔默政府能否在2026年5月地方选举中避免重大失败？
title.en: Will the Starmer government avoid a major defeat in the May 2026 local elections?

yes.zh: 工党在2026年5月英格兰地方选举中净失席位少于200席，视为
yes.en: Labour loses fewer than 200 net council seats in the May 2026 English local elections, deemed 'avoiding a major defeat'

no.zh: 工党净失席位超过200席，媒体普遍定性为重大失败
no.en: Labour loses 200 or more net council seats, widely characterised as a major defeat

title.zh: 斯塔默总理能否在2026年5月前挺过工党内部
压力？
title.en: Will Starmer survive a Labour leadership confidence challenge before May 2026?

yes.zh: 工党未在2026年5月1日前发起正式领导层信任投票，或斯塔默在信任投票中胜出
yes.en: No formal Labour leadership confidence vote is triggered before May 1, 2026, or Starmer wins any such vote

no.zh: 工党在截止日期前触发领导层信任投票且斯塔默落败
no.en: A Labour leadership confidence vote is triggered and Starmer loses before the deadline

title.zh: 英国法院积压案件能否在2026年底前出现减少趋势？
title.en: Will UK court backlogs begin to decrease by end of 2026?

yes.zh: 英国司法统计数据显示2026年Q4英格兰及威尔士皇家法院待审案件总数低于2026年Q1水平
yes.en: UK justice statistics show total Crown Court backlog in Q4 2026 lower than Q1 2026 levels

no.zh: 2026年Q4积压案件数量等于或高于Q1水平
no.en: Crown Court backlog in Q4 2026 equals or exceeds Q1 2026 levels

title.zh: 英国议会能否在2026年通过加密货币政治捐款临时禁令？
title.en: Will UK Parliament pass a temporary ban on crypto donations to political parties in 2026?

yes.zh: 英国议会在2026年12月31日前通过立法，对加密货币政治捐款实施临时或永久禁令
yes.en: UK Parliament passes legislation banning crypto donations to political parties (temporary or permanent) before December 31, 2026

no.zh: 年内未通过相关立法
no.en: No such legislation passed within the year

title.zh: 英国5月选举后，苏格兰国家党能否继续主导苏格兰议会？
title.en: Will the SNP retain control of the Scottish Parliament after the May 2026 elections?

yes.zh: 苏格兰国家党在2026年5月苏格兰议会选举后仍为议会最大党并继续执政
yes.en: SNP remains the largest party in Holyrood and continues to govern after the May 2026 Scottish Parliament election

no.zh: 其他政党或联盟在选举后获得执政权
no.en: Another party or coalition takes power after the election

title.zh: 斯塔默能否在2026年维持与特朗普的友好关系？
title.en: Will Starmer maintain a friendly relationship with Trump throughout 2026?

yes.zh: 2026年12月31日前，英美双边关系未因特朗普-斯塔默分歧而出现重大外交危机（制裁、大使召回等）
yes.en: No major diplomatic crisis (sanctions, ambassador recall, etc.) between the US and UK attributable to Trump-Starmer tensions before December 31, 2026

no.zh: 英美关系在2026年出现重大外交破裂，媒体普遍将其归因于两国领导层分歧
no.en: A major UK-US diplomatic rupture occurs in 2026, widely attributed to leadership tensions

title.zh: 英格兰NHS新合同能否确保全科医生当日预约正式落地？
title.en: Will the new NHS GP contract guaranteeing same-day urgent appointments be formally implemented in England?

yes.zh: 英国政府宣布新的全科医生合同正式生效，要求为紧急病例提供当日预约
yes.en: The UK government officially implements the new GP contract requiring same-day urgent appointments in England

no.zh: 新合同因谈判破裂或延迟，在2026年内未能正式落地
no.en: The new contract fails to be formally implemented in 2026 due to negotiations breakdown or delays

title.zh: 瑞秋·里夫斯的春季声明能否宣布额外削减支出？
title.en: Will Rachel Reeves' Spring Statement announce additional spending cuts?

yes.zh: 财政大臣在2026年春季声明中宣布超过50亿英镑的新增支出削减
yes.en: The Chancellor announces more than £5bn in additional spending cuts in the 2026 Spring Statement

no.zh: 春季声明未宣布重大新增削减措施
no.en: No major new spending cuts announced in the Spring Statement

title.zh: 英国CPI通胀率能否在2026年Q2降至2%目标以下？
title.en: Will UK CPI inflation fall below the 2% target in Q2 2026?

yes.zh: 英国国家统计局公布的2026年4月、5月或6月任一月份CPI年率低于2.0%
yes.en: ONS reports UK CPI annual rate below 2.0% in any month of April, May, or June 2026

no.zh: 2026年Q2全部三个月CPI均维持在2%或以上
no.en: UK CPI remains at or above 2.0% in all three months of Q2 2026

title.zh: 英格兰银行能否在2026年内将利率降至3%以下？
title.en: Will the Bank of England cut interest rates below 3% in 2026?

yes.zh: 英格兰银行在2026年12月31日前将基准利率降至3.0%以下
yes.en: Bank of England cuts its base rate below 3.0% before December 31, 2026

no.zh: 2026年内基准利率维持在3.0%或以上
no.en: Base rate remains at 3.0% or above throughout 2026

title.zh: 美国贸易逆差能否在特朗普关税政策下于2026年内收窄？
title.en: Will the US trade deficit narrow under Trump's tariffs in 2026?

yes.zh: 美国商务部公布的2026年全年货物贸易逆差低于2025年全年逆差（以美元计）
yes.en: US Commerce Department reports full-year 2026 goods trade deficit lower than full-year 2025 deficit in dollar terms

no.zh: 2026年全年逆差等于或高于2025年
no.en: The 2026 full-year deficit equals or exceeds the 2025 level

title.zh: 英国2026年1月录得历史最高政府财政盈余，能否连续两年实现1月盈余？
title.en: Will the UK government record a January surplus for two consecutive years in 2027?

yes.zh: 英国国家统计局公布2027年1月公共财政数据显示盈余（即政府税收超过支出）
yes.en: ONS reports a UK public sector surplus in January 2027 (tax receipts exceeding spending)

no.zh: 2027年1月公共财政出现赤字或持平
no.en: UK public finances show a deficit or break-even in January 2027

title.zh: 里夫斯能否在2026年IFS评估中获得
认定？
title.en: Will Reeves receive an IFS assessment of compliance with fiscal rules in 2026?

yes.zh: IFS在2026年对春季声明或秋季预算的评估中认定政府当前处于财政规则合规轨道
yes.en: IFS assesses that the government is on track to comply with fiscal rules in its 2026 analysis of the Spring Statement or Autumn Budget

no.zh: IFS认定政府偏离财政规则轨道，或需进一步削减/加税
no.en: IFS determines the government is off-track on fiscal rules, requiring further cuts or tax rises

title.zh: 黄金价格能否在2026年Q1突破3200美元/盎司？
title.en: Will gold price break $3,200/oz in Q1 2026?

yes.zh: 伦敦金现货价在2026年3月31日前任意时刻达到或超过$3,200/盎司
yes.en: London spot gold reaches or exceeds $3,200/oz at any point before March 31, 2026

no.zh: Q1结束前未能突破$3,200/盎司
no.en: Gold fails to reach $3,200/oz before end of Q1 2026

title.zh: 特朗普任命的美联储主席凯文·沃什能否在2026年获得参议院确认？
title.en: Will Trump's Fed pick Kevin Warsh be confirmed by the Senate in 2026?

yes.zh: 美国参议院在2026年12月31日前投票确认凯文·沃什担任美联储主席
yes.en: US Senate confirms Kevin Warsh as Federal Reserve Chair before December 31, 2026

no.zh: 沃什提名在年内被否决、撤回或未获投票
no.en: Warsh nomination is rejected, withdrawn, or not voted on within the year

title.zh: 英国青年失业率能否在2026年底前降至13%以下？
title.en: Will UK youth unemployment fall below 13% by end of 2026?

yes.zh: 英国国家统计局公布的16-24岁青年失业率在2026年第三或第四季度降至13%以下
yes.en: ONS reports UK youth (16-24) unemployment below 13% in Q3 or Q4 2026

no.zh: 2026年内青年失业率维持在13%或以上
no.en: UK youth unemployment remains at 13% or above throughout 2026

title.zh: 美国经济能否在2026年上半年避免衰退（连续两季度负增长）？
title.en: Will the US economy avoid a recession (two consecutive quarters of negative growth) in H1 2026?

yes.zh: 美国商务部公布的2026年Q1和Q2 GDP数据显示至少一个季度为正增长
yes.en: US Commerce Department reports positive GDP growth in at least one of Q1 or Q2 2026

no.zh: 2026年Q1和Q2 GDP均为负增长，满足技术性衰退定义
no.en: Both Q1 and Q2 2026 US GDP are negative, meeting the technical recession definition

title.zh: 哈利·布鲁克能否带领英格兰在ICC冠军赛（T20世界杯赛季）中夺冠？
title.en: Will Harry Brook lead England to win the ICC Champions Trophy / T20 World Cup tournament in 2026?

yes.zh: 哈利·布鲁克作为英格兰队长，带领英格兰赢得2026年ICC冠军赛或相关主要板球锦标赛冠军
yes.en: Harry Brook captains England to win the 2026 ICC Champions Trophy or the main ICC cricket tournament of 2026

no.zh: 英格兰在该赛事中未能夺冠
no.en: England fail to win the tournament

title.zh: 博多/格利姆特能否在欧冠淘汰赛阶段再创奇迹晋级？
title.en: Will Bodo/Glimt advance past the Champions League round of 16?

yes.zh: 博多/格利姆特在2025-26赛季欧冠淘汰赛阶段赢得1/8决赛两回合，晋级8强
yes.en: Bodo/Glimt win their Champions League round of 16 tie over two legs and advance to the quarter-finals

no.zh: 博多/格利姆特在1/8决赛中被淘汰
no.en: Bodo/Glimt are eliminated in the round of 16

title.zh: 纽卡斯尔联能否从欧冠淘汰赛晋级至8强？
title.en: Will Newcastle United advance to the Champions League quarter-finals?

yes.zh: 纽卡斯尔联在2025-26赛季欧冠1/8决赛两回合中胜出，晋级8强
yes.en: Newcastle United win their Champions League round of 16 tie over two legs and reach the quarter-finals

no.zh: 纽卡斯尔在1/8决赛中被淘汰出局
no.en: Newcastle United are eliminated in the round of 16

title.zh: 热刺能否在2025-26赛季英超成功保级？
title.en: Will Tottenham Hotspur avoid relegation in the 2025-26 Premier League season?

yes.zh: 热刺在2025-26赛季英超赛季结束时排名第17位或以上，保级成功
yes.en: Tottenham Hotspur finish 17th or above in the 2025-26 Premier League and avoid relegation

no.zh: 热刺排名第18位或以下，降级至英冠
no.en: Tottenham finish 18th or below and are relegated to the Championship

title.zh: 维斯塔潘离开红牛的传言——霍纳是否在2026赛季前离开红牛车队？
title.en: Will Christian Horner leave Red Bull Racing before the start of the 2026 F1 season?

yes.zh: 克里斯蒂安·霍纳在2026年F1新赛季开始前正式离开红牛车队管理职位
yes.en: Christian Horner officially departs his management role at Red Bull Racing before the 2026 F1 season opener

no.zh: 霍纳在2026赛季开始时仍担任红牛车队管理职位
no.en: Horner remains in his management role at Red Bull when the 2026 F1 season begins

title.zh: 梅威瑟对帕奎奥复赛能否超过100万付费观众？
title.en: Will the Mayweather vs Pacquiao rematch attract over 1 million pay-per-view buys?

yes.zh: 梅威瑟与帕奎奥复赛的全球付费点播观众总数超过100万人次
yes.en: The Mayweather vs Pacquiao rematch records more than 1 million global pay-per-view buys

no.zh: 付费点播观众总数为100万或以下
no.en: Global pay-per-view buys total 1 million or fewer

title.zh: 特拉维斯·凯尔西能否宣布正式退役？
title.en: Will Travis Kelce officially announce his retirement from the NFL?

yes.zh: 特拉维斯·凯尔西在2026年6月30日前正式宣布从NFL退役
yes.en: Travis Kelce officially announces his retirement from the NFL before June 30, 2026

no.zh: 凯尔西未在截止日期前宣布退役，或续约参加下赛季
no.en: Kelce does not announce retirement before the deadline or signs for another season

title.zh: 英格兰女足球员威廉姆森能否就赛程问题与英足总达成协议，避免罢赛？
title.en: Will England Women's captain Leah Williamson and players reach an agreement with the FA over scheduling, avoiding a strike?

yes.zh: 英格兰女足球员与英足总在2026年6月30日前就赛程安排达成协议，未发生罢赛行动
yes.en: England Women players and the FA reach a scheduling agreement before June 30, 2026, with no strike action taken

no.zh: 谈判破裂，英格兰女足球员实施罢赛或拒绝征召
no.en: Negotiations break down and England Women players carry out strike action or refuse call-ups

title.zh: 2026年六国赛，英格兰能否在六国赛剩余轮次中赢得超过一场胜利？
title.en: Will England win more than one remaining game in the 2026 Six Nations?

yes.zh: 英格兰在2026年六国橄榄球锦标赛余下的比赛中赢得至少两场
yes.en: England win at least two of their remaining 2026 Six Nations matches

no.zh: 英格兰在剩余比赛中赢得一场或零场
no.en: England win one or zero of their remaining 2026 Six Nations matches

title.zh: FIFA世界杯能否顺利在墨西哥城举办而不受安全事件重大影响？
title.en: Will the 2026 FIFA World Cup in Mexico proceed without major security incidents affecting matches?

yes.zh: 2026年FIFA世界杯在墨西哥境内举行的全部赛事顺利完成，无因安全事件导致比赛取消或重大中断
yes.en: All 2026 FIFA World Cup matches played in Mexico are completed without cancellations or major disruptions due to security incidents

no.zh: 因安全事件，至少一场世界杯比赛被取消、迁移或出现重大安全中断
no.en: At least one World Cup match in Mexico is cancelled, relocated, or majorly disrupted due to security concerns
